Skill npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev Installs the main skill with the library of 27+ production-ready transitions.

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex and Gemini CLI. Polish skill npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev -s transitions-polish An add-on that aligns motion you already have to the transitions.dev token scale. Works alongside the main skill or on its own. Pro skill npx transitions-dev skill Installs the Pro transitions

as an agent skill, with CSS, React and TypeScript for every recipe. Needs a Transitions Pro plan: it opens your browser once to confirm your account, then drops the recipes into your skills directory. Pro recipes npx transitions-dev add --pro Copies every Pro recipe

straight into ./transitions/ . Signs you in through the browser the first time. Prefer the free set? Use npx transitions-dev add --free . Commands Type them to your agent, or say it in plain words: each command lists the phrases that route to it. Reveal transitions reveal Lists every transition in the skill as a numbered text list, handy when you have forg

my animations". Apply transitions apply Detects the best-fit transition for your current cursor context, proposes it with a one-line rationale, then installs it after you confirm. Name a transition to skip the detection, for example transitions apply menu-dropdown . Also triggers on "add the right transition here". Refine transitions refine Scans the whole project for ad-hoc transitions, hardcoded durat

delay rules on top of the token matching from transitions refine , plus explicit distance coverage. Read-only, nothing gets edited. Needs the Polish skill installed. Also triggers on "polish my transitions" or "align to the motion tokens".
